about_the_game:
Enter a challenging survival world full of dangers, discoveries, and decisions.

In this single-player survival game, your survival is the focus. Gather resources, build your own base, and craft equipment to face the elements.

Explore different biomes – from scorching deserts to icy snowscapes – each region presents new challenges. The right clothing is crucial: a straw hat will protect you from the sun, while a winter jacket is vital in the cold.

Find abandoned locations, loot valuable items, and face dangerous creatures. Firearms like pistols are rare but can be purchased from merchants for resources or currency.

In addition to surviving, you can also build your own small farm: Buy animals from a merchant and breed animals to provide for yourself in the long term.

You're on your own – how long can you survive?
